MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 32
   C. 9
   D. 64

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 60
   C. 19
   D. 30

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
